draft.subject: Photographing Harbour Winds at The Example Room.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Harbour Winds is playing The Example Room on April 2. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage from the back of the house, and I've been a photographer at Carnegie Hall for nearly 10 years. My rate is $250 an hour plus tax, one-hour minimum, with the gallery delivered within two weeks. Recent work is at danwrightphotography.com/music. Happy to answer any questions.
